reviews.text: The team here was great from start to finish. I loved that Jay designed a pool based on our backyard that definitely looks as if it has been there from the beginning. The pool colors to choose from were absolutely stunning. Hats off to all the workers, Jay, and Curtis for answering all the questions I had. This was my very first time building a pool and it was amazing! I truly enjoyed the excitement of it all. My family and I  thank you so much for making a dream our reality!!! 💕
reviews.author: tameka williams

reviews.text: We recently hired DFW Custom Pool to do a refresher on our pool which was last remodeled in 2009.  The pool needed to be replastered and some of the coping reset. The decking also needed new mastic. DFW did a great job. The job was supervised  by Eric who was very responsive in answering questions and addressing any issues that arose. DFW also got it done in just a few weeks which wasn't easy because we had a lot of rain while they were trying to do the job. DFW also redid my law partners pool.  He recommended them to me.  I also highly recommend them to anyone else needing to update/refresh the look of their pool!
reviews.author: George Boll

reviews.text: Absolutely loved working with DFW Custom Pools! Mitch was amazing to work with, really understood what we wanted, and helped us to design our dream backyard. Our project manager, Kurtis, went above and beyond to make our dream a reality. During the build process, Kurtis was always very responsive to any questions we had and proactive about letting us know about scheduling or scheduling changes. We’ve gotten so many compliments from friends and family, and would highly recommend DFW Custom Pools if you’re wanting a turn-key, custom job!
reviews.author: Brittany Bachelor

reviews.text: DFW Custom Pool did a great job in installing our pool and working with other contractors to make sure everything works together and the pool was ready to go in less than 90 days. Kurtis has been especially helpful and responds to our questions promptly. Thanks for everything!
reviews.author: Mark Ritchie

reviews.text: Gene and his crew did a great job on our pool. Highly recommended. They work with you after the install as well. We had a LED light issue and they took care of all the warranty issues the following week.
reviews.author: Carl Plaxco

reviews.text:
Not up to my standards, but the pool is functionalI, if you are the type of person that is ok with someone using caulk to fix a crack on a new granite counter, then this is your company. Everything is paid upfront; you are left alone and in the dark, once it has water. The company was supposed to tend to the pool for the first bit, have never had anyone come check the pool. ( except for the joke of a pool school as they call it) The decking was 4” short of matching the existing porch, and drawing. with significant gaps between pavers most have been fixed. Paver crew isn’t bad other than, never knowing when they’re going to be here. Chalk line stains everywhere.Plaster left behind on expensive glass tile. Now it looks faded in some places, and covered with plaster.. Now, I’m going to have to pay a professional to clean up the plaster. mud stains on the bottom . I had already had to clean up after construction myself. They were to direct rain water flow around the pool. It is directly in the pool. Still have to clean pencil measuring marks off the stone, and the glue is the worst. I had to clean the house inside and out because of dust. I was told the outside would have been pressure washed on clean-up. It was highly recommended to use Ludder stone; it was a horrible decision; stained and has already cracked. All this and have not even got a final city Inspection yet.Very disappointed. Getting something done after water is in the pool is impossible, probably because everything has been paid. The retainer wall is cracked and falling. I Personally had to show them That they had not poured any other cells when I build the retaining wall. Even though they installed rebar. Met with the owner of the pool company he showed his sub, what to do and They still do not fix it correctly. You personally have to babysit them. You can see by the pictures what kind of work has been done.
Promised they would put the fence back if they cut the bracing, and I would never know They removed it. (Welding skills in picture) Not even close.
I do have to give props to Derrick as a Forman, I also understand many things are out of his control. The company is only as good as it’s subcontractors. See pictures below!!

GOOD FROM FAR, FAR FROM GOOD
reviews.author: Marcus Cleveland

reviews.text: They do go away.  Trying to get service for items still under warranty, you are ignored.  You also have to stay on top of them while they built the pool to make sure they are using the correct equipment and building it correctly. The pool is wonderful but if any issues occur after final payment, they won't get resolved.
reviews.author: Chocovamp Onlydark

reviews.text: We hired Gene to remodel our pool on a recommendation from a neighbor down the street. We had it resurfaced and new tile installed. It was immaculately refinished, the tile is exactly what I envisioned, and the work was completed quickly. We have had other contractors work on our property before and it was a complete nightmare. He made me trust contractors again -- the work was done on time and the subs were good workers and didn't leave a huge mess. His prices are also at least 5-10K less than other local pool companies for remodeling. I'd rec him in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Sally Loisel

reviews.text: I had the opportunity to work with Jake Diaz as our designer for our backyard pool project. Jake is very knowledgeable and professional. Jake provided us with our dream backyard that we absolutely love. The process with the build was on time. Everyone was friendly and polite. We experienced a problem and John came out immediately and solved the problem. The only problem that we have experienced was trying to get some of the outside contractors out to correct some small issues.
reviews.author: RONALD WALKER

reviews.text: We used DFW Gene to remodel our old pool. He did this plus added a fire pit and rebuilt the grill area. It looks great and transformed the entire backyard. We love it. Highly recommend reaching out to them to help with your pool.
reviews.author: Jamie DePuma

reviews.text: I am very dissatisfied with the customer service this company has provided. They are not responsive and have had to "fix" and "fix" and "fix" problems from the start. We have 3-1/2 pages of issues we have encountered over the last 5 months of the pool build.  We are finally almost finished (not there yet though), just in time for winter and when asked what they are going to do for us.....nothing. When a customer  spends OVER six figures on a pool, WE expect competence and some sort of compensation for all the issues and delay.  Because of us, our neighbors built at the same time with DFW pools and have had very similar issues.
reviews.author: Robin Garrett

reviews.text: I had a great experience with my pool build. I would definitely recommend DFW Custom Pool anyone looking for a new pool.
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.text: DFW Custom Pools finished my pool from signing contract to pool fill day 142 in days. With that said, a month of that we were waiting on the permit from my city as they took a very long time and another month was in May due to it pretty much raining off and on all month. If you remove that which was out of their control, then they were able to work on my pool and finish it in 70 days which is just over 2 months which during covid and how the pool industry is right now is amazing. Just like any build, there were bumps along the way. I don’t think I can do an accurate review if I didn’t include that, but the communication was there and that to me is the most important part. I am fine with bumps in the road if the communication is there, so I am not just wondering what is going on. I will say, I am working from home, so I saw every progress along the way, and I am sure they got tired of me calling and texting, but they took it very well and very professional. Gene, the owner is full of knowledge and is a no non-sense communicator and that is what I like. I am a grown man and I can take bad news; I just want accurate news and updates. Michael his son, is learning the business and he was my main point of contact the entire time and if he couldn’t answer me, which wasn’t often then he would find out and get back to me. I love the way my pool turned out. They did us all subs to do the work, but the subs were spot on with all of their work and if I had questions and went out and asked, they stopped and took the time to answer me.  I actually started with another pool company and we decided to part ways because their communication was not up to my standards before the permits even came back.  I will say there are 2 things I wish I would have known or been advised on. I wish I had a bubbler with a light in it in my tanning ledge because even with my pool being small (14X28) and having 2 lights in the pool, at night my ledge is pretty dark. The other one is my bubbler isn’t independent so it is on the same line as my sheer decent (water fall) and my cleaner so when those are on, it affects the flow and how high or low the bubbler goes which sometimes is a pain. With that said, overall I am very pleased with my pool and my wife and 3 year old loves it. We have used it almost every day since it was done. The quality of work was outstanding and the people were great.
reviews.author: Michael Cupp

reviews.text:
I remodeled an original 1982 gunite pool in spring 2021. We had a great interaction with Gene from the get go. He was transparent, honest, and really just one of the nicest guys I've met. The guy has a mind like a steel trap.

His quote came in about 5k less than the other guys and he was able to start within 2 weeks. He was responsive via text or phone at all hours answering my dumb questions and providing me great updates throughout the process. We had a bit of a delay with the gunite guys but that was expected and he worked hard to make it right. The pool is beautiful. We resurfaced, redid the tile, coping, decking, rock wall, and built a new tanning ledge. Everything was great.

We've since recommended Gene to any family and friends who ask for a pool company to build new or remodel as his crews were polite, responsive, and performed excellent work.
reviews.author: Michael DePaola

reviews.text:
We had a pool installed by DFW CUSTOM POOLS.   From the first day we told the salesman JR and the owners son Michael who was the project manager that we would have to have water brought in because we did not know the capacity or capabilities of our water well.   We spoke about this several times throughout the build.   We were leaving town for a wedding right before the plaster was finished and reminded Michael for the 10th + time that we did not want to use our well.   We leave town, my mom comes to watch the house and 2 hoses are run, one from well house one from rear of house and pool is more than half full and hoses are sputtering.  They ran the well dry.   This pushed sediment and iron in to plying of entire house.

It is now a month later and we have been no showed by plumbers several times and the ball got dropped.   We were told that a claim had been filed on the plaster companies insurance on 11-17 but when we called for information 11-23 the claim had still not been filed.   Claim now was supposed to be filed but DFW CUSTOM POOLS still refuses to provide a copy of their insurance.    Poor service and very shady work after the fact.   The general contractor needs to take responsibility and get this issue solved.   VERY DISAPPOINTED
reviews.author: Priceless Spray Foam Roofing and Coatings Price

reviews.text: Freeze damage to existing pool - had two companies quote to repair - DFW Custom Pools were honest, knowledgeable, professional, great quality work and end results we are thrilled with!  Would recommend for sure.
reviews.author: Karen Etchison

reviews.text:
Sales guy was OK, didn't own up to mistakes that cause me extra money, pool build was fine but electrician used were horrible and unreliable.
Pool turned out great and was done quickly. But next to impossible to get back for to correct things.
reviews.author: David Casarez

reviews.text: Good family owned business who knows what there doing. Professional contractors &  good communication throughout my family’s pool/deck build. I Highly recommend them  if your in the market for a new pool.
reviews.author: Justin Langley

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic, depicting a competent but imperfect contractor. Positive reviews are detailed and specific. Negative reviews reveal a clear, repeated pattern of poor follow-up service and warranty support after final payment, which is a significant concern. There is no evidence of review manipulation.

negative_evidence: Trying to get service for items still under warranty, you are ignored (Chocovamp Onlydark)
if any issues occur after final payment, they won't get resolved (Chocovamp Onlydark)
positive_evidence: They took care of all the warranty issues the following week (Carl Plaxco)

authentic_signals: Specific project details (remodels, freeze damage, specific crew names)
Mix of praise and detailed constructive criticism
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
complaint_patterns: Lack of responsiveness after final payment
Need for constant supervision during build
Specific build quality issues (decking mismatch, caulk fixes)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Limited review data on other platforms; available Google and BBB ratings are positive and not contradictory.
